## Summary

Describe what changed and why.

## Type of change

- [ ] feat (new feature)
- [ ] fix (bug fix)
- [ ] docs (documentation)
- [ ] test (tests only)
- [ ] refactor (no behavior change)
- [ ] chore (tooling/maintenance)

## Related issues

Closes #

## Validation

- [ ] `pytest -v` passes
- [ ] `ruff check src/ tests/` passes
- [ ] `mypy src/` passes (when relevant)
- [ ] Added/updated tests for new behavior
- [ ] Updated docs/examples for user-facing changes

## Checklist

- [ ] Follows project conventions in CONTRIBUTING.md
- [ ] Uses clear commit messages (Conventional Commits)
- [ ] Keeps scope focused (one logical change)
- [ ] Includes `--json` support for new CLI commands (if applicable)

## Notes for reviewers

Anything specific you want reviewers to focus on.
